title: Preserve clock evidence bytes through Git line-ending normalization

changes.description: Correct CHG-20261014-001 archive portability before commit: Git would normalize CRLF in two Windows outputs and invalidate captured-byte hashes. Preserve exact originals as base64 with decoded byte/digest checks; keep original manifest/checker checkpoint and all native run bytes. Application code, .gitattributes, clock guard and executable fingerprint unchanged.

Fresh static capsule check compares24 payload digests and staged Git bytes, validates decoded original Windows hashes and retains all comparison/restoration assertions; native documentation closure remains separate.

documentation_reviews.reason: Explain exact-byte encoding, retained checkpoint and final24-payload capsule instead of implying CRLF raw text survives Git unchanged.
Identify the corrective archive record and staged-byte proof, with no change to diagnosed mechanism or repair/privacy gates.
Record encoded and decoded digests and retain prior manifest/checker; no timestamp rewriting or evidence result promotion.
Add decoded-byte checks and explicit staged-index equality for each archived payload.

verification.scope: Static container final24-payload capsule: all digests, exact decoded original Windows bytes, staged Git equality, comparison arithmetic, mode-selected clock adjustments/cleanup and unchanged executable/configuration/requirement bytes.
Final static docs:check after capsule portability correction, covering generated views, classified current docs, links and unchanged sealed history with timing-valid receipt.

limitations: This is archive portability, not clock repair or additional application/CI/device acceptance.
RUN003 checked the original22-payload capsule before this correction; the staged-byte check supplies current capsule qualification.
